Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 5, Verse 23

“One who can withstand here, before release from the body, the force born of desire and anger — that person is disciplined, and that person is happy.”

The word vega, surge or force, is exact. Krishna is describing something with momentum that arrives whether invited or not, and endurance as the thing worth building.
